about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for vibration2005 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The tree section holds this paragraph plus the text of the following Schedule 1 Part I paragraphs (the ahv formula, both-hands rule and combined-operations formula), which are not in this provision's source, so several provisions are merged into one.
findings.evidence: tree: "To avoid confusion between vibration magnitude and daily exposure to vibration, it is conventional to express daily exposure to vibration in m/s2 A(8)."

findings.problem: The tree ends with a sentence that is not in this provision's source; it probably comes from the next paragraph of Part II.
findings.evidence: tree: "The exposure to vibration averaged over one week is for use only for the purposes of Regulation 6(5)."
